v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cor contrítum * et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
text.en: A contrite and a humbled heart, * O God, thou wilt not despise.

text.la: Propter nomen tuum, * Dómine, vivificábis me in æquitáte tua.
text.en: For thy name's sake, * O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

text.la: Deus, tu convérsus * vivificábis nos, et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
text.en: Thou wilt turn, O God, * Thou wilt quicken us and bring us to life.

text.la: Cum irátus fúeris, * Dómine, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
text.en: When thou art angry, * O Lord, thou wilt remember mercy.

text.la: Lauda * Deum tuum, Sion, qui annúntiat iudícia sua Israël.
text.en: Praise thy God, * O Sion, who declareth his judgments to Israel.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Múlier, * quæ erat in civitáte peccátrix, stans retro secus pedes Dómini, lácrimis cœpit rigáre pedes eius et capíllis cápitis sui tergébat, et deosculabátur pedes eius et unguénto ungébat.
text.en: A woman in the city which was a sinner stood at the Lord's Feet behind Him, * and began to wash His Feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed His Feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut observatiónes sacras ánnua devotióne recoléntes, et córpore tibi placeámus, et mente.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who every year do earnestly renew the sacred observance of this Fast, may please thee both in body and in soul.

title.la: S. Thomæ de Villanova Episcopi et Confessoris
title.en: St. Thomas of Villanova, Bishop and Confessor

text.la: Eleemósynas illíus enarrábit omnis ecclésia Sanctórum.
text.en: All the congregation of the Saints shall declare his alms.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Thomam Pontíficem insígnis in páuperes misericórdiæ virtúte decorásti: quǽsumus; ut, eius intercessióne, in omnes, qui te deprecántur, divítias misericórdiæ tuæ benígnus effúndas.
text.en: O God, Who didst adorn the blessed Bishop Thomas with the grace of an excellent pitifulness toward the needy, we entreat thee for the same thy servant's sake mercifully to pour forth the riches of thine own pitifulness upon all them which cry unto thee.
